cohort: The study included 300 live births extracted from delivery registers and obstetric records at the Maternal and Child Health block of Lakhimpur Medical College and Hospital, Assam.
finding: The study found a substantial burden of low birth weight (33.33%) in Upper Assam, with significant associations observed with adolescent motherhood, primigravida status, grand multiparity, and pregnancy-induced hypertension.
cross-section timing: Data was collected retrospectively over one year, from October 2022 to September 2023.
birth_weight: Less than 2500 grams (definition of LBW); most LBW neonates weighed between 1.5-2.5 kg.
gest_age: Gestational age was analyzed, but no specific range for the cohort was provided as a finding.
